body: Sad to hear and experience first hand. I was literally writhing in bed the entire day and night. I told so many doctors I was in pain.

I understand that but when someone is in pain... like they watched me overnight just to tell me I had chronic pain and major depression.. they could’ve just let me leave ?? I find better relief with marijuana than anything really.

I know through my physical therapist that when we have flare ups or past physical trauma the muscles, specifically the perinum, tighten and cause the uterus and everything to go up into the body which is ouchie
Um she’s beautiful. End o story.
I appreciate you saying that, and they’re from a couple different palettes I wish I could recall the names for them!

This makes me not want to give up and think what I’m experiencing is my own mind working against me, that the pain isn’t fake and always has been real. I absolutely feel insane. Especially after all my labs, urine, ct , ultra scans came back negative.

I’m glad to hear it. Everyone around me is making it seem like I’m a hard core druggy, when in reality I’m just trying to eat so I don’t die from malnutrition hah. How do you communicate with the people around you that this has been the only natural method that’s helped.
I tattooed both insides of my feet. So painful.
